map.链传动初选：基于传递功率、小链轮转速与传动比，按 06B~24A 滚子链额定表（: Chain drive pre-selection: based on power, small-sprocket speed and ratio, select from the 06B-24A roller-chain rating table (19-tooth single-strand basis) and correct rating power by small-sprocket teeth and strand count; when no table entry qualifies, clearly flag the range overflow instead of silently using the largest chain. Results are for pre-selection only; recheck with service factor and bearing loads.
map.💡 链条速度 v = z₁ × p × n₁ / (60×1000)；大链轮齿数: Chain speed v = z1 x p x n1 / (60x1000); z2 = z1 x i; chain number is matched after power x speed factor and tooth/strand corrections.
Algorithm: speed factor = n>3000 to 1.5, >1500 to 1.2, >500 to 1.0, otherwise 0.9; corrected power = power x speed factor; small-sprocket teeth z1 by n: >2000 to 25, >1000 to 21, otherwise 17, forced odd; tooth factor kz = z1/19, strand factor ks = 1.0 single / 1.75 double / 2.5 triple; equivalent required power = corrected power / (kz x ks); from the rating table 06B (9.525 mm/3 kW/9000 rpm), 08A (12.7/10/7000), 10A (15.875/20/5000), 12A (19.05/40/3500), 16A (25.4/80/2500), 20A (31.75/150/1800), 24A (38.1/250/1300) take the first chain satisfying maxKw >= equivalent required power and maxRpm >= n; if none qualifies, flag overflow explicitly and show 24A as a reference; equivalent rated power = maxKw x kz x ks; z2 = round(z1 x i), add 1 if even; chain speed v = z1 x pitch x n / (60x1000) (m/s); center distance = 40 x pitch; pitch count = round(2a/p + (z1+z2)/2 + ((z2-z1)/(2pi))^2 x p/a), add 1 if odd. Lubrication: v<0.6 grease, v<8 oil bath, otherwise oil spray.
Example: 5.5 kW, 960 rpm, i=3, single strand: speed factor 1.0, corrected power 5.5 kW; with z1=17 the tooth factor is 0.895 and equivalent required power 6.1 kW, so 08A is selected (10 kW rating, equivalent rated 8.9 kW), pitch 12.7 mm, z2=51, chain speed 3.45 m/s, large-sprocket speed 320 rpm, center distance 508 mm, 116 pitches, judged medium-speed / oil-bath. At 30 kW, 1450 rpm, single strand: speed factor 1.0, z1=21, tooth factor 1.105, equivalent required 27.1 kW, select 12A (equivalent rated 44.2 kW), chain speed 9.67 m/s, judged high-speed / oil spray. At 400 rpm, 2.2 kW, single strand: speed factor 0.9, corrected 1.98 kW, equivalent required 2.2 kW, still 06B (equivalent rated 2.7 kW), z1=17. At 400 kW, 960 rpm, single strand: equivalent required about 447.1 kW exceeds the largest 24A (equivalent rated about 223.7 kW), so the page flags overflow instead of silently passing 24A.
